title: Colors
description: Colors is a dynamic and fun plugin for the Minecraft server that adds a unique "Color Platforms" mini-game!
body:
**Colors is an exciting and dynamic mini-game plugin that brings vibrant, fast-paced platform challenges to your Minecraft server! Forget static builds; dive into a game where quick thinking and even quicker reflexes determine who stands victorious.**

**What does it do?**

• Generates diverse color platforms: Players must quickly identify and move to the correct colored platform each round.

• Dynamic round system: Round times adjust, and incorrect platforms disappear, increasing difficulty as the game progresses.

• Intuitive player guidance: Clear on-screen titles tell players which color to stand on.

• Engaging BossBar timer: A visual countdown keeps players informed of the remaining time, intensifying the challenge.

• Automatic cleanup: Platforms are automatically removed between rounds and upon game conclusion, keeping your world tidy.

• Seamless integration: Works with modern Paper/Spigot versions (e.g., Paper 1.21.1+).

• Configurable game settings: Adjust minimum and maximum round times via a simple YAML file.

**Why should you use it?**

• Boosts player engagement: Offers a unique and fun mini-game that encourages interaction and competition.

• Simple to start: Easy /colors start command to begin the game from your current location.

• Lightweight and efficient: Designed to run smoothly without impacting server performance.

• No annoying particles: Enjoy a clean, fluid gameplay experience without visual clutter.

• Easy to manage: Stop games or reload configurations with straightforward commands.

• Pure skill-based fun: Challenges players' agility and reaction time.
**
Perfect for:**

• Mini-game servers: A great addition to a lobby or game hub.

• Community events: Perfect for server-wide competitions and fun gatherings.

• Survival servers: Provides a unique activity to break up the routine.

_Any server wanting to add a simple, yet addictive, interactive game._
